description: She wears an opaque floor-length muted plum-purple dress with a fitted bodice, low square neckline and elbow-length sleeves. Narrow gold woven geometric borders run along the neckline, shoulder strips, waist, long vertical skirt edges and hem. Four circular brooch-like fittings decorate the upper bodice and waist. A substantial cream patterned wrap rests along her forearms and hangs at both sides, with muted plum geometric designs. A cream underdress shows at the lower front, and brown decorated shoes appear below the hem. A small green-stone ring and delicate earrings are visible. The design is simpler than ceremonial aristocratic dress, with modest ornament and textured cloth.
